stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[2].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable
[LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[4].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

required_fields.statement: Each missing required field yields an error naming its path.

type_checks.statement: Wrong types for string, integer, number, boolean, array, object are reported; bool is not integer/number.
must_include: types string integer number boolean array object

enum_check.statement: A value not in the enum list is reported.

number_bounds.statement: Numbers below minimum or above maximum are reported; boundary values are accepted.

string_length.statement: Strings shorter than minLength or longer than maxLength are reported; boundary lengths are accepted.

regex_pattern.statement: Strings not matching pattern (re.search) are reported.

nested_paths.statement: Errors in nested objects are reported with dot-separated paths such as server.port.

all_errors.statement: Multiple violations in one config are all reported, one per line, exit code 1; valid config exits 0; bad input files exit 2.

single_file_stdlib.statement: config_validator.py is one file importing only standard library modules.
